client: Charlon Farms and Agro Allied Services Ltd
headline: An agribusiness needed a corporate structure that could grow as fast as its harvest.
challenge: Agro-allied businesses span farming, processing and distribution, each with its own documentation needs. That makes a single coherent corporate structure essential.
delivered: Company formation covering integrated agro-allied operations
Business development advisory on market and distribution opportunities
HR documentation for seasonal and permanent farm labour
Administrative support for supplier and off-take agreements
impact: An agribusiness formally structured to manage production, people and partnerships as a single, accountable company.
